cards.example_en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
cards.example_zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为understood。

cards.example_en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
cards.example_zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We thank the cooks when the festival dinner ends.
cards.example_zh: 节日晚宴结束时，我们感谢厨师们。

cards.example_en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
cards.example_zh: 我们走了很远，走得脚都开始疼了。
cards.explain_zh: far可修饰比较级，如far better；不用far good。

cards.example_en: Reliable public transport can make commuting far more affordable for people who live outside major city centres.
cards.example_zh: 可靠的公共交通可以让住在大城市中心以外的人通勤时省下很多钱。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
cards.example_zh: 今天天气暖和，我们到外面吃饭吧。
cards.explain_zh: today既可指今天，也可泛指当今；前面不用on。

cards.example_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
cards.example_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。
cards.explain_zh: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。

cards.example_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
cards.example_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
cards.example_zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。
cards.explain_zh: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

cards.example_en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。
cards.explain_zh: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

cards.example_en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。
cards.explain_zh: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

cards.example_en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
cards.example_zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。
cards.explain_zh: idea是可数名词；“不知道”可说have no idea。

cards.example_en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。
cards.explain_zh: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

cards.example_en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
cards.example_zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。
cards.explain_zh: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

cards.example_en: My room has a desk beside the window.
cards.example_zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。
cards.explain_zh: 指房间时可数；指空间或余地时不可数。

cards.example_en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
cards.example_zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。
cards.explain_zh: until强调持续到某时；by强调不迟于某时。

cards.example_en: The heavy rain was the reason we stayed home.
cards.example_zh: 大雨是我们待在家里的原因。
cards.explain_zh: 常用reason for加名词，或reason why加从句。

cards.example_en: One reason for rising urban rents is that housing supply has failed to keep pace with population growth.
cards.example_zh: 城市租金上涨的一个原因是住房供应未能跟上人口增长。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
cards.example_zh: 那些云呈现出一只巨兔的形状。
cards.explain_zh: fill in a form是英式说法；美式常用fill out a form。

cards.example_en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
cards.example_zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。
cards.explain_zh: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

cards.example_en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
cards.example_zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。
cards.explain_zh: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

cards.example_en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
cards.example_zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。
cards.explain_zh: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

cards.example_en: Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
cards.example_zh: 与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。
cards.explain_zh: learn to do表示学会做；过去式可用learnt或learned。

cards.example_en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。
cards.explain_zh: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

cards.example_en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
cards.example_zh: 只有一个人在面包店外等候。
cards.explain_zh: 普通复数用people；persons多见于正式法律语境。

cards.example_en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。
cards.explain_zh: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

cards.example_en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
cards.example_zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
cards.example_zh: 我每两周给这株小仙人掌浇一次水。
cards.explain_zh: once引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

cards.example_en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
cards.example_zh: 每位俱乐部成员都带了一道菜与大家分享。
cards.explain_zh: 表示某团体的成员，用a member of。

cards.example_en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
cards.example_zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。
cards.explain_zh: 修饰名词放前面，修饰形容词或副词放后面。

cards.example_en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
cards.example_zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。
cards.explain_zh: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

cards.example_en: We explored the city on foot all afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在步行游览这座城市。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为cities；市中心英式用city centre。

cards.example_en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

cards.example_en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
cards.example_zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
cards.example_zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

cards.example_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
cards.example_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
cards.explain_zh: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

cards.example_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
cards.example_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I don't know whether he will come.
cards.example_zh: 我不知道他会不会来。

cards.example_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
cards.example_zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
cards.explain_zh: 排队在美式英语中常用stand in line，英式常用queue。

cards.example_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
cards.example_zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: All the children were present for the class photo.
cards.example_zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。
cards.explain_zh: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

cards.example_en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
cards.example_zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。
cards.explain_zh: side with表示支持某方；side by side表示并排。

cards.example_en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
cards.example_zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。
cards.explain_zh: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

cards.example_en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
cards.example_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。
cards.explain_zh: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

cards.example_en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
cards.example_zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？
cards.explain_zh: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

cards.example_en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
cards.example_zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
cards.example_zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。
cards.explain_zh: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

cards.example_en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
cards.example_zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。
cards.explain_zh: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

cards.example_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
cards.example_zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。
cards.explain_zh: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。

cards.example_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
cards.example_zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
word.example_zh: 我们走了很远，走得脚都开始疼了。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
word.example_zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
word.example_zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Extending the railway line could connect rural communities with employment opportunities in nearby cities.
word.example_zh: 延长铁路线可以让农村社区的居民获得附近城市的就业机会。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Investing in insulation can reduce costs in the long term.
word.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资保温设施能够降低成本。

word.example_en: The two options differ in terms of cost and convenience.
word.example_zh: 这两个选择在成本和便利性方面有所不同。
